basis: studies/phase17/reports/phase_c2_time_scale_materiality.md (IMPLEMENT: T2 full TDB-TT series, T3 topocentric TDB, T4 clock offset at the 1 us level; CONVENTION_REAL_DATA: T1 UTC tags; owner accepted s5.2 and s5.3 on 2026-10-22, report s7)

architecture.new_module_station_time: src/lunar_od/station_time.py (new file, no frozen identity). (a) tdb_minus_tt(et0_s, t_s, site=None): the full Fairhead-Bretagnon TDB-TT series of ERFA dtdb, geocentric when site is None, with the topocentric terms for a site (elong, u, v from ITRF metres); the epoch enters as a two-part value so et0 + t is never formed (C1 lesson 1). (b) tdb_minus_tt_rate(et0_s, t_s, site=None): the analytic derivative of (a), term by term (C1 lesson 2). (c) Site.from_itrf_m(r_ecef_m). (d) utc_to_tdb_seconds(utc_tags, et0_s, site): UTC tags (ISO strings or a calendar-date/seconds-of-day pair) -> TDB seconds past et0, through TAI-UTC from the loaded leapseconds kernel (DELTET/DELTA_AT), TT = TAI + 32.184 s, TDB = TT + (a) at the site; the result is formed as whole days and fraction separately so the only rounding is the final double. dtdb's ut argument is UTC (UT1 is C3)
architecture.series_source: a mechanical port of dtdb.c from ERFA 2.0.1 (the liberfa source inside the pyerfa 2.0.1.5 sdist, downloaded in agent-sandbox and pinned by sha256 in the commit message). The coefficient table is generated by a script from the C source, never typed by hand; the generator and the source sha256 are committed with the port. Licence: ERFA BSD-3 notice kept in the module header (and a LICENSES entry); no new runtime dependency
architecture.relativistic_light_time_changes: src/lunar_od/relativistic_light_time.py (no frozen identity). LightTimeModel gains station_time: 'DELTET_GEOCENTRIC' (default; the C1-I behaviour, bit-identical) | 'FULL_TOPOCENTRIC'. With FULL_TOPOCENTRIC and interval_time_scale='TT': two-way range and counted Doppler convert each station-measured interval with the exact difference D_site(t3) - D_site(t1) of station_time.tdb_minus_tt at the station's site, replacing rate x round trip; delta-DOR reports the delay in station time, D_TT = D_TDB - [D_B(t_B) - D_A(t_A)], each D at its own station (this carries the -(V.b)/c^2 term, owner decision s5.2). Station sites are taken from pass_geo.stations[i].r_ecef_m in the pass-level API and passed as an optional argument to the solvers. Partials keep the C1-I convention (the interval scale is a constant factor of the geometric partial; its state dependence is ~1e-10 relative)
architecture.model_constants: DSN_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL keeps its C1-I meaning and bytes of output. A new DSN_C2_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL = SSB + Shapiro Sun, Earth + TT + FULL_TOPOCENTRIC. Pass metadata gains a station_time key; metadata without it is read as DELTET_GEOCENTRIC, so every C1-I pass and record reproduces unchanged. Switching the generator default to the C2 model is NOT part of C2-I (a later owner decision)
architecture.station_clock_consider: owner decision s5.3. (a) The SSB observables accept a per-station clock offset b_s (production convention of RangeRatePhysicsConfig.station_clock_offset_s: the receive tag is read as t + b_s) in generation and prediction, default 0 (bit-identical). (b) Analytic partials dh/db_s for two-way range and counted Doppler (the receive-epoch sensitivity of the implicit event equations; zero in the two-way interval of one clock) and for delta-DOR (b_B - b_A enters the delay directly). (c) A new module src/lunar_od/consider_covariance.py: given the square-root posterior information R (from BLS/SRIF), the weighted state design H_x W^1/2, the weighted consider design H_c W^1/2 and the consider a priori covariance P_cc, returns the sensitivity S = -P_x H_x^T W H_c and P_consider = P_x + S P_cc S^T, computed without forming the normal matrix (QR, R1COV lesson). The a priori sigma is a required input with no default value; no estimator change
architecture.untouched_production_modules: estimators.py (frozen; re-frozen for C1-I), measurement_ingestion.py (frozen), two_way_range.py, radiometrics.py, delta_dor.py, measurements.py keep their bytes. The SSB estimator dispatch already routes through relativistic_light_time's pass-level API, so the C2 model reaches BLS-LM and SRIF through pass metadata without an estimators.py edit. UTC ingestion is delivered as station_time.utc_to_tdb_seconds, to be called before read_measurement_csv's t_s column is used; wiring it into the CSV reader is out of scope
architecture.out_of_scope: scenarios.py / scenario JSON / desktop plumbing; switching DSN_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL or the generator default; clock frequency (immaterial, report s3); the clock offset as a solve-for; UT1/EOP (C3); the production Moon-centred observables

gates.G1_default_invariance: with no opt-in, the full suite has no new failure relative to main on the same machine; on all 10 KP2 cells, DSN_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL and LightTimeModel() outputs (two-way range, counted Doppler, delta-DOR on CANON k0) are bit-identical to the C2 branch base (d24e380), max |diff| = 0
gates.G2_series_port: against pyerfa 2.0.1.5 in the sandbox: |port - erfa.dtdb| <= 1e-15 s, geocentric and at sites, on the 28,358 C2 survey epochs plus a grid of 2,000 epochs 1950-2100 x 10 sites (3 DSN + 7 random); the analytic rate vs a central difference of the port with h = 1 s on the two-part epoch, max |diff| <= 1e-6 x |rate| + 1e-19
gates.G3_utc_chain: (a) TAI-UTC from the LSK equals erfa.dat exactly at +-1 s around every leap second 1972-2017 and on 1,000 random epochs 1972-2050; (b) utc_to_tdb_seconds vs the pyerfa chain utctai -> taitt -> dtdb(site), on 1,000 random tags 1980-2050 at the 3 DSN sites and on the C2 survey epochs: max |diff| <= 1e-10 s (the double floor of t_s ~ 1e5 s is 1.5e-11 s)
gates.G4_survey_parity: with DSN_C2_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL, the per-row change from DSN_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL reproduces the C2 survey on all 10 cells: two-way range vs T2_RATE + T3_RATE within 1e-5 m; counted Doppler vs T2_RATE + T3_RATE within 1e-9 m/s; delta-DOR (CANON k0) vs T3_DIFFERENTIAL + TT_INTERVAL_INFO within 1e-12 s. The epoch parts (T2_EPOCH, T3_EPOCH) are qualified as tag differences: utc_to_tdb_seconds minus the SPICE chain (str2et-equivalent with DELTET) equals the survey's (ERFA - SPICE) and topo values within 1e-10 s
gates.G5_jacobians: analytic partials vs central finite differences, best over a step sweep, max relative error, DSN_C2 model: two-way range and delta-DOR <= 1e-6, counted Doppler <= 1e-5 (C1-I G5 thresholds), on 3 cells x 20 rows; clock-offset partials dh/db <= 1e-6 (range, delta-DOR) and <= 1e-5 (Doppler) on the same rows
gates.G6_estimator_closure_no_degradation: BLS-LM and SRIF on noise-free DSN_C2 truth with the DSN_C2 estimator (CANON k0 range-only six-state, the C1-I G6 construction) close no worse than the C1-I model on its own truth: |closure_C2 - closure_C1I| <= 1 mm in position for each estimator, status Converged (certified). The absolute closure is not gated (C1-I G6: integrator-limited, Phase D)
gates.G7_bias_mapping_crosscheck: the DSN_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL estimator on DSN_C2 truth (CANON k0 range-only, noise-free, six-state + K) ends at a state offset whose sigma-normalised components agree within 10 % (largest component) with the linear bias mapping of the module's own per-row change (the C2 survey method)
gates.G8_consider: (a) S from consider_covariance equals the linear-solve response of the same posterior to a unit clock-offset bias on the data within 1e-8 relative (per column); (b) P_consider is symmetric, P_consider - P_x is positive semidefinite (smallest eigenvalue >= -1e-12 x its largest), and for P_cc = 0 it equals P_x bit-for-bit; (c) on CANON k0 RANGE_DOPPLER_FREE_BIAS at DSN_REALISTIC weights with sigma_b = 1 us, the largest consider-induced sigma inflation is reported and checked against the survey's T4 1 us OD ratio (0.14): the consider sensitivity |S b|/sigma for b = 1 us agrees with the survey's linear bias mapping within 10 %
gates.G9_informational: OD impact of the C2 model on the KP2 population (RANGE_ONLY and RANGE_DOPPLER_FREE_BIAS, PROJECT and DSN_REALISTIC), reported for the record; it does not gate

amendment_A1.G6: the predeclared clause 'status Converged (certified)' contradicts a result known before this predeclaration: on the same construction the C1-I model's own closure ended DampingLimit (BLS-LM, 11.6 m) and MaxIter (SRIF, 0.11 m), integrator-limited (C1-I G6, owner-accepted adjudication; Phase D). The gate's intent is no degradation, so the status clause becomes: each estimator's status on DSN_C2 truth equals its status with the C1-I model on its own truth, both computed in the same G6 run from the same start. The 1 mm position clause is unchanged
amendment_A1.G5_steps: the step sweep is the union of the two C1-I sweeps (pos 1, 10, 100 m; vel 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1 m/s; K 1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2), with exact-epoch station states; chosen before any C2-I G5 number, because the C1-I default K steps sat in finite-difference noise (C1-I G5 adjudication)
amendment_A1.interval_difference: D_site(t3) - D_site(t1) is evaluated as round_trip x d(TDB-TT)/dt at the interval midpoint (analytic station_time rate), which equals the exact difference to ~1e-20 s, rather than as the difference of two ~1.5e-3 s values, which carries eraDtdb's ~2e-17 s epoch-sum quantisation (G2). Delta-DOR uses the two station values directly (different sites; the predeclared form)
